sloka: तस्यास्मि कृतसङ्केता लोकपालसुतस्य वै ।तमुद्दिश्य तु मे सर्वं विभूषणमिदं कृतम् ।। ७.२६.३५ ॥
transliteration: tasyāsmi kṛtasaṅketā lokapālasutasya vai ।tamuddiśya tu me sarvaṁ vibhūṣaṇamidaṁ kṛtam ।। 7.26.35 ॥

translations.english: I am indeed promised to him, the son of a Lokapala, and all these ornaments I wear are for his sake.
